verdict.rationale: Postmark is an email API service, so a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is a fair question. The evidence shows no such spec: the probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file that does exist is a prose documentation index for LLMs, not a machine-readable API specification. It is adjacent material and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
